_comment: BIM-Watch source registry. Data, not code -- edit freely, no redeploy logic needed.
Every url below was verified live on 2026-07-25: HTTP 200, parseable, non-empty.
enabled       set false to mute a source without losing its history
weight        nudges ranking in the weekly briefing (0.5 quiet .. 1.5 loud)
expect_days   typical days between posts; 3x this with no items = stale badge
Known-dead, deliberately not listed (checked 2026-07-25, do not re-add blindly):
thebuildingcoder.typepad.com  domain parked -- the Revit API blog is gone
speckle.systems/blog          404 (the GitHub releases feed covers it instead)

sources.name: Autodesk Platform Services
sources.note: Developer/API feed. The single best alert-tier source.

sources.name: Autodesk AEC blog (was the Revit blog)
sources.note: Product announcements, releases, roadmap. The old Revit-blog URL now 301s to the merged AEC blog; kept as-is because it is the stable public entry point.

sources.name: Autodesk News
sources.note: Corporate: acquisitions, licensing, strategy. Lower signal, real impact.

sources.name: pyRevit releases
sources.note: Version-support matrix changes show up here first.

sources.name: Revit add-in templates
sources.note: Tracks new Revit versions as they gain template/SDK support.

sources.name: Revit Add-ons
sources.note: DORMANT as of 2026-07-25: no post in ~288 days, so it will show a stale badge. Left enabled deliberately -- its back catalogue is worth searching, and if it revives we want it. Disable if the badge annoys you.

sources.name: AEC Magazine
sources.note: High volume. The classifier earns its keep here.

sources.name: Graphisoft (Archicad)
sources.note: Competitor watch -- what the other side of the market is shipping.

sources.name: Speckle releases
sources.note: openBIM / interoperability. Was speckle-sharp until 2026-07-25 -- that repo's last release was 2025-07-11 and the stale check caught it; speckle-server is the active one.
